statement: ∀ (β a t C : ℝ), 0 < C → (∀ f g : KdVPlan.Coeff, KdVPlan.MemH gamma f → KdVPlan.MemH gamma g → KdVPlan.ZeroMean f → KdVPlan.ZeroMean g → KdVPlan.HB β (KdVPlan.stage a t f g) (C*KdVPlan.hn gamma f*KdVPlan.hn gamma g)) → ∀ w, KdVPlan.MemH gamma w → KdVPlan.ZeroMean w → KdVPlan.SeqConv β (fun n : ℕ => KdVPlan.stage a t (KdVPlan.cutoff (n : ℝ) w) (KdVPlan.cutoff (n : ℝ) w)) (KdVPlan.stage a t w w)
proof:
intro β a t C hC hb w hw hzw
refine ⟨(hb w w hw hw hzw hzw).1, ?_⟩
intro ε he
have hn : 0 ≤ KdVPlan.hn gamma w := Real.sqrt_nonneg _
let K := C*(1+2*KdVPlan.hn gamma w)
have hK : 0 ≤ K := by dsimp [K]; positivity
rcases exists_pos_mul_lt he K with ⟨η, hη, hsmall⟩
let δ := min 1 η
have hδ : 0 < δ := lt_min (by norm_num) hη
rcases (h_T013.2.2.1 gamma w hw).2 δ hδ with ⟨m, hm⟩
refine ⟨m, ?_⟩
intro n hnm
let f := KdVPlan.cutoff (n : ℝ) w
have hh : KdVPlan.HB gamma (f-w) δ := hm n hnm
have hadd := yui_aux_0001 T gamma R h_H002 h_E004 h_T014 h_T015 h_T013 gamma (f-w) w hh.1 hw
have hf : KdVPlan.MemH gamma f := by simpa only [sub_add_cancel] using hadd.2.1
have hnf : KdVPlan.hn gamma f ≤ 1+KdVPlan.hn gamma w := by
  have h := hadd.2.2
  rw [sub_add_cancel] at h
  exact h.trans (add_le_add (hh.2.trans (min_le_left 1 η)) le_rfl)
have hzf : KdVPlan.ZeroMean f := by
  unfold KdVPlan.ZeroMean at *
  simp [f, KdVPlan.cutoff, hzw]
have hzd : KdVPlan.ZeroMean (f-w) := by
  change f 0-w 0 = 0
  rw [hzf, hzw, sub_self]
have hf0 := (h_T013.2.2.2.1 0 gamma f h_H002.1.le hf).1
have hw0 := (h_T013.2.2.2.1 0 gamma w h_H002.1.le hw).1
have hdiff := yui_aux_0014 T gamma R h_H002 h_E004 h_T014 h_T015 h_T013 a t f w hf0 hw0
have H₁ := hb (f-w) f hh.1 hf hzd hzf
have H₂ := hb w (f-w) hw hh.1 hzw hzd
have H := yui_aux_0001 T gamma R h_H002 h_E004 h_T014 h_T015 h_T013 β _ _ H₁.1 H₂.1
change KdVPlan.HB β (KdVPlan.stage a t f f-KdVPlan.stage a t w w) ε
rw [hdiff]
refine ⟨H.2.1, le_of_lt (lt_of_le_of_lt (H.2.2.trans (add_le_add H₁.2 H₂.2)) ?_)⟩
calc
  C*KdVPlan.hn gamma (f-w)*KdVPlan.hn gamma f+C*KdVPlan.hn gamma w*KdVPlan.hn gamma (f-w) ≤ C*δ*(1+KdVPlan.hn gamma w)+C*KdVPlan.hn gamma w*δ := by gcongr <;> exact hh.2
  _ = K*δ := by dsimp [K]; ring
  _ ≤ K*η := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (min_le_right 1 η) hK
  _ < ε := hsmall
